newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index end down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index end down in slow trading.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed down on Monday in sluggish trading, with investors waiting for companies to post interim results, brokers said.
The index lost 0.320 point or 0.62 percent to 51.709 on volume of 7.1 million shares worth $2.5 million. Of 41 B shares, 31 traded, with 13 down, nine flat and nine up.

Brokers said that investors are taking a wait-to-see attitude over the final few days for B share companies to post their results. All companies are required by exchange rules to post results before September 1.
"Several firms have published very disappointing results, hurting market sentiment," one broker said. "Many investors were cautious, waiting for the remaining company results."
"The index will move in a narrow range in the next few days before all the results are published," said a second broker.
Shanghai Jinjiang Tower performed the worst today, falling $0.018 or 7.25 percent to $0.230, on volume of 200,000 shares.
Shanghai Chlor Alkali Chemical followed, dipping $0.012 or 5.17 percent to $0.220, on volume of 989,400 shares.
Shanghai Worldbest traded the most, ending unchanged at $0.300, on volume of 2.1 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index ended sharply down on poor interim results of most listed firms, brokers said.
It fell 32.756 points or 3.90 percent to 807.470 points, on volume of 270.0 million shares worth 2.5 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index lost 59.447 points or 2.81 percent to 2053.521 points.

China Sichuan International was the biggest loser after posting a 0.77 yuan per share loss in its interim report. The stock plunged 5.64 yuan or 47.03 percent to 6.35 yuan, on volume of 6.9 million shares.
